mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, which may be potentiated in elderly patients taking donepezil, and both drugs can accumulate with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function and auditory function closely; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal clearance; use alternative antibiotics if possible in elderly patients on cholinesterase inhibitors.
